That is an access/environment failure, not proof the code is absent, so 'not-present' is unavailable as a ground — refuting requires file:line locations I actually read, and I read none. I likewise could not check for an already-existing guard (e.g. an aggregation-only flag gating the blank-skip), nor enumerate the other call sites of Arguments.iterate to see whether MATCH/INDEX/VLOOKUP/COUNTBLANK-style positional or blank-counting functions actually flow through it. The named file is on the authoritative changed-file list, so the finding is not pre-existing, and unconditional blank-skipping that compacts a range sequence would be an in-lane correctness bug (shifted positional indices, wrong blank counts, changed AVERAGE semantics) with critical impact if real. Per the rubric, uncertainty keeps the finding.
